card.name: Start of the word unintentional
card.fires_on: The first part of "unintentional" (split as "unintention" + "al") after words like from, with, or the, in safety and exposure sentences. Weaker on "to" after words like familiar or limit.

modes.label: Start of unintentional
modes.description: The word "unintention" right before "al", describing accidental exposure, injection, or release.
modes.example: Ensure safe drug handling to protect patients and health care providers from<< unintention>>al radiation exposure.

modes.label: The word to after an adjective or noun
modes.description: A weaker response on "to" after words such as familiar or limit.
modes.example: ) so they are familiar<< to>> the student - logs have been kept
